metadata.case_name: CHIU PO LING, A MINOR SUING BY HIS MOTHER AND NEXT FRIEND, SHEK KAM KIU v. WONG YUET

injuries.description: wound with tissue loss over left infra-orbital area
source: Physical examination showed wound with tissue loss over left infra-orbital area.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of eyelid or periocular area

injuries.description: 33 mm x 2mm pale, atrophic scar over the medial aspect of the Plaintiff’s infra-orbital area causing mal-functioning of his left lower eyelid
injuries.body_part: medial infra-orbital area / left lower eyelid
source: Dr. Ho found a 33 mm x 2mm pale, atrophic scar over the medial aspect of the Plaintiff’s infra-orbital area causing mal-functioning of his left lower eyelid.

manifestations.description: left lower eyelid cannot close tight with the result that some light can still filter through
pale, atrophic scar over infra-orbital area (visible scarring)
development of a certain degree of cynophobia (fear of dogs)
schoolmates made fun of him, accusing him of being a rabies-carrier or a monster

treatments_received: injection of first dose of anti-rabies vaccination
attendance at outpatient clinic at PWH

losses.description: minimal scarring below left eye (33 mm x 2mm pale, atrophic scar) with cosmetic injury
development of cynophobia and teasing by schoolmates (accused of being a rabies-carrier or a monster)

comparable_cases.case_name: Susi Yanti and Lo Ka-ying etc. v Chu Shiu-chuen
comparable_cases.injury_description: Lo Ka-ying, a girl aged 4 when attacked by a pack of dogs ... she suffered 3 laceration wounds over both thighs and multiple minor bite and scratch marks over her thighs and left arm ... faint pale scar over her left shoulder, a slightly noticeable pale scar on her right thigh near the knee region, a raised pale scar on the front of the left upper thigh as well as several barely perceptible bite marks and a slightly pigmented raised irregular laceration scar with 2 noticeable pairs of stitch marks on the back of her upper thigh. Plastic surgery was not indicated.
